hooks.name: todo-afterlife-precommit
hooks.description: Runs node scripts/hooks/todo-afterlife-precommit.mjs before every shell tool call and acts only on git commits. Today it reports that TODO Afterlife is not built yet; the todo-afterlife build task makes it run TODO Afterlife over the staged diff (deterministic, no LLM, no network). It blocks nothing and fails open: any internal error exits 0 with a warning.
